definitions.explanation: An indefinite number of hours, typically implying somewhere between two and five or six hours.

examples.japanese: {数時間|すうじかん}{待|ま}った。
{手術|しゅじゅつ}は{数時間|すうじかん}かかる{見込|みこ}みだ。
examples.english: The surgery is expected to take several hours.

examples.japanese: {停電|ていでん}で{数時間|すうじかん}にわたって{電気|でんき}が{使|つか}えなかった。
examples.english: Due to the power outage, electricity was unavailable for several hours.

notes:
A common time expression using the prefix {数|すう} (several) with the time counter {時間|じかん} (hours).

RELATED TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- {数分|すうふん}: several minutes
- {数日|すうじつ}: several days
- {数週間|すうしゅうかん}: several weeks
- {数ヶ月|すうかげつ}: several months
- {数年|すうねん}: several years

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数時間|すうじかん}{後|ご}: several hours later
- {数時間|すうじかん}{前|まえ}: several hours ago
- {数時間|すうじかん}おきに: every few hours
- {数時間|すうじかん}にわたって: for several hours (duration)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何時間|なんじかん}か: some hours — slightly more vague
- {二、三時間|にさんじかん}: two or three hours — narrower range
